items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: "Sopa de Pichon" - because, you know, there was ahh an atmosphere, happy atmosphere... and they called that particular happy cigarette. "Pichon"........

ctx.x: I see. Okay. Macho, I understand there - that's where you wrote "Sopa de Pichon", your first hit and "La Paella" and a lot of other things for the years to come, that you lived there. What inspired your first hit recording, "Sopa de Pichon"?
Oh!! "Sopa de Pichon" - because, you know, there was ahh an atmosphere, happy atmosphere, and about - have a good time, forget it - and they called that particular happy cigarette. "Pichon"........
